caption: The drawing depicts a circular plate-like object centered on a plain, off-white background. The design consists of multiple concentric rings. The outermost ring is medium brown, filled with a fine stippled texture, and is bordered by two thin black lines. Just inside this, there is a thin white band, then another thin black line. Moving inward, there is a blue and white band featuring a geometric pattern of regularly spaced rectangles and notches. Towards the innermost part, there is a thin solid black ring, followed by another white band with a scalloped pattern made from small curved loops, which encircle a large central white space. The signature "Edith Abney" is written in cursive in the lower-right quadrant of the drawing, outside of the central circular design.
title: Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
